purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-mail-setup. S* must route here (sending mail from the app, SMTP setup, template editing, documented mail symptoms); N* must NOT — the sharpest boundary is Jenkins build-result email, which belongs to cicd-setup.
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors

baseline_result.method_note: Text-isolated: judges read a compiled listing (14 real skills + 9 distractors: superpowers, frontend-design, skill-creator, mattpocock), all 27 mail+upload queries interleaved in a per-judge randomized order, expected answers never shown.
baseline_result.note: S-side 24/24 → ugt-nextjs-mail-setup, including the three symptom phrasings that never say "อีเมล" as a task (S5 silent non-delivery, S6 relay rejection, S7 dead link). N-side 18/18 stayed away, and every one landed on its expected owner unanimously — N1 (Jenkins build mail) → cicd-setup 3/3, the sharpest boundary in the set. Sole secondary variance: N5 (test a finished mail function) → (no skill) 3/3 where the note suggested TDD; that is judge conservatism about a distractor, not a boundary defect. No description change needed.

revalidation_2026-09-06.reason: Description cut 1090→878 chars (spec limit 1024): symptom causes (localhost:25, SMTP_FROM, basePath, mail-step throw) moved to a SKILL.md "When to use" table; symptoms themselves stay as keywords.
revalidation_2026-09-06.method_note: Judges ran as 6 subagents (3 judges × 2 batches, each judge's 186-query set shuffled with its own seed) given the skill listing as TEXT generated from the repo SKILL.md frontmatter at this commit (17 ugt skills) plus distractor descriptions from the installed superpowers 6.3.0, mattpocock-skills 1.2.3 and frontend-design caches — 47 entries total. Instructed to answer only from the listing; no judge named an environment skill. Because BOTH pipelines were listed, secondary answers that hit the mattpocock twin of an expected superpowers skill are counted as misses by the strict scorer but are not routing errors.
revalidation_2026-09-06.note: S-side 24/24 incl. all four symptom queries after their causes moved to the body. N-side 18/18 primary (Jenkins emailext trap avoided 3/3). Secondary 16/18: N4 (standard toast look) → none 2/3 vs design-setup 1/3 — design-setup/none wobble, not this boundary.
